Prevention: Information on pathogen history in the area so that non-infested sites for crop production can be selected
Do, at least, four year crop rotation with non-host crops (Tomato, Potato, Bean)
Cruciferous crop debris (Cabbage, Cauliflower, Broccoli, Knol-khol) before cultivation
Apply lime (2 t/ha), two weeks before planting, to
Increase soil pH Use poultry litter (10 t/ha) as organic manure to reduce disease severity
Establish nurseries in disease-free fields to produce healthy seedlings
Do not use infected crop debris for compost preparation
Remove and destroy alternate hosts (e.g. wild mustard, wild radish)
Monitoring: Infected seedlings show small galls on roots or clubbed roots
Look for wilted leaves/ plants during the hottest part of the day
When uprooted, plants show enlarged root system
At latter stages, the clubbed roots will rot and disintegrate
Restrictions: Chemical controls are not available for club root
